scripts.setup: npm install && cd apps/api && composer install && php -r "file_exists('.env') || copy('.env.example', '.env');" && php artisan key:generate --ansi && php artisan migrate --graceful --ansi
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd" "cd apps/api && php artisan serve --port=8003" "cd apps/web && npm run dev"
